description: Find U.S. manufacturers of a product. Returns (1) registered exporters: companies with a U.S. plant that Fromerica reviewed before publishing (Pro-plan companies are listed first and marked paid_placement=true), and (2) separately, unclaimed listings of U.S. manufacturers in the same industry built from public government records (not Fromerica members, not verified, not contactable through Fromerica). Always returns the link where the buyer can post a free request for quote (no account, 0% commission); Fromerica looks for matching U.S. manufacturers.

product.description: Product the buyer is looking for, e.g. "tractor parts".

name: find_us_exporters
